translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

content: De-en pomon to id lammi kowd to Monama, tonani rowd iddos langun no morat no pinuungan, no idda en so kod-aakaa, kodpo-uvag-uvag, od kosina woy dos osengan nod pokoddora-at to duma.

Na, iling to anak no lammid tobbow no inaayun od kopiyan nod susu, ko-ilangan mandad no inaayun kow od kopiyan to kahit Monama no waa sambut, su amoy od tuvu pe-en kos koniyun kopomakoy taman tod kopongnga iddos kodtobbus din koniyu.
Oyyos noheddaman dowd iddos kopiyannoy tod Longaggon.
Si Disas kos Ma-antoy'n Batu

Porani kow ki Disas Krays nod Longaggon, su ma-antoy sikandin woy od boggoy to umuun waad tomanon. Oyyos sikandin kos ma-antoy'n batu no od pokomosalig to baoy, woy sikandin en kos id aam to Monama woy id dokollan din to koru-anon. Piru inin batu, id oovoddan to mgo tohodbovaoy.

Na sikiyu, pomon to novoggayan kowd man to umuun waad tomanon, noko-iling kowd mandad to ma-antoy'n mgo batu nod kovovallan no baoy't Monama. Noko-iling kow mandad to mgo tohodbuwis no id po-ossa atag kandin. Woy ukit to tavang ni Disas Krays, od pokobovuwis
kowd diyot Monama taddot id kahaa-i rin, no idda en so kodsimba riyot kandin ukit to Ispiritu rin.
Oyya su no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Pomotawi row! Id aam ku iddos batu no oray'n dakkoo kos koru-anon no mosalig no po-unsaran taddot baoy ku riyot bonuwa to Sion.
Dos ahad ondoy nod pomakoy kandin, konna en od pokodsondit, su od kosolihan man sikandin.”

content: Atag koniyu nod pomakoy, dakkoo en kos koru-anon ka-ay'n batu. Piru atag taddot diid pomakoy, duwon no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: “Iddos batu no id oovoddan to mgo tohodbovaoy, idda en baling kos od pokomosalig taddot baoy.”

content: Woy duwon mandad no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: “Ini en kos batu no od pokoposi-ud to mgo minuvu, woy od pokoporudsu kandan.”

content: Od pokorudsu sikandan, oyyos dii ran man od pomakoy to kahit Monama, su ini en kos tapoy'n puhawang din taddot konnod pomakoy.

Piru sikiyu, id aam kow to Monama no mgo minuvu rin. Mgo hari kow riyot kohoriyan din woy mgo tohodbuwis kow no id puung atag kandin. Id ossa kow nikandin amoy od dumoruma kandin diyot tivuk no ginawa row. Monama kos id pongomunoy koniyu, woy id aam kow nikandin amoy'd poso-ob taddot nonaw moka-atag to mokososoobbun pinuungan din. Oyya su dangan, diyon kow to mosukirom pomon to koniyun mgo saa, piru id polegguang kow nikandin pomon diyot mosukirom woy id alin diyot mokososoobbun ko-owangan din.
Dangan, konna kow pa mgo minuvu to Monama, piru ko-ungkay, mgo minuvu kowd nikandin. Dangan, waa row notanggap iddos eru to Monama, piru ko-ungkay, notanggap dowd en.
Dos Ollog no Kodbovotasan to mgo Minuvu to Monama

Id ginowannan ku no mgo suwod, noko-iling to mgo moholiyug ki ra ka-ay to ampow't ingod, oyyos konna ka-ay kos bonnaan ingod ta. Purisu od buyuwon ku koniyu, no yo kow od ikuu to morat no mgo ingowollon to lawa row, su ini en kos od pokopiyod koniyu riyot kodpuung to saa no od supak to ginawa row riyot kodpuung to id kopi-it Monama.

Ko-ilangan no inaayun motallong kos kodbovotasan dow riyot mgo minuvu no waa Monama. Su otid puungan dow ini, ahad pa od osengon dan ko-ungkay no morat kow, piru od kokita ran diyot mori, no motallong bos kos pinuungan dow. Pomon ka-ay, od posivontuhan dan kos Monama riyot kod-undini rin amoy od hukum keta.
Dos Kodpo-iraom taddot Duwon Kotungud diyon to Guberno
Na atag to bantug tod Longaggon, ko-ilangan nod po-iraom kow to kodponguu taddot langun no duwon kotungud koniyu. Dumoruma kow taddot hari to Roma, oyyos sikandin man kos duwon lampas no kotungud.
Po-iraom kow mandad to kodponguu to mgo gubernador, su sikandan kos id solihan to hari no od silut taddot od puung to morat, woy od doong taddot od puung to moppiya.
Oyya su iyon id kopi-it Monama, no motallong kos pinuungan dow amoy'd kotampod iddos kodsawoy koniyu to mgo minuvu no waa sinorollan to kovonnaan.

Na sikiyu, su duwon don man kolegguangan dow, worad od pokobaavag koniyu to ahad ondan no id kopi-i row nod puungan. Piru yo row ini bovalli no unayan nod puungan dowd iddos ahad ondan no morat. Iyon dow puungi, pokita row no mgo uripon kow en to Monama.
Rispitu-i row iddos langun no minuvu, woy ginowanni row iddos mgo suwod dow riyon to kopomakoy. Ko-ilangan no duwon allak dow to Monama woy rispitu-i row iddos hari to Roma.
Dos Pomandu atag to mgo Uripon

Na sikiyu mandad no mgo uripon, rispitu-i row kos koniyun mgo amu woy po-iraom kow to kandan no kotungud. Konna no iyon dow ra od rispituwan iddos mgo amu no moppiya kos botasan, ko konna, ahad iddos amu nod ayu-ayu koniyu.
Od kahaa en iddos Monama, otid koti-is dow iddos kodposuppit to koniyun mgo amu ahad waa saa no nopuungan dow.
Oyyos waa koru-anon otid ti-is kow to mgo lampos pomon to morat kos id puungan dow. Piru otik od koti-is dow iddos kodposuppit pomon to motallong no pinuungan dow, id kahaa-i kow en to Monama.

Id aam kow to Monama amoy'd ti-is to mgo kodposuppit, oyyos si Disas Krays, id ti-is mandad to kodposuppit atag koniyu, woy id boggoy koniyu to ponunggelengan amoy'd ikulon dow iddos kodbovotasan din.
Waa sikandin id puung to saa woy waa en id ouhus.

To id sumpalit sikandin, waa rin idda tovaka to morat. To id posokitan sikandin, waa en sikandin id balus nid oseng to morat. Iyon din id puungan, id salig din baling iddos langun diyon to Monama no ollog kos kodhukum.

Si Disas Krays kos id tiyang to keton mgo saa ukit to kodpakpak kandin diyon to krus, su amoy konna kid od puung to saa, woy iyon tad od puungan iddos motallong. Woy pomon taddot mgo pali nid ti-is din, idda en kos noko-uli keta.
Dangan, to waa kow pa mid pomakoy ki Disas Krays, noko-iling kow to notarin no mgo karnero. Piru ko-ungkay, nokolivod kowd diyot ki Disas Krays no Tohodtamong woy Tohod-okudi koniyu.

footnotes.text: Od kovasa ini riyot Roma 12:1; Hebreo 13:15.
